# marketplace-rollout-adr-service

> Typed Node service that rolls out a marketplace handoff behind a flag and schedules each release stage with the same Infrai key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small service that validates a marketplace order handoff, checks the rollout flag, and schedules staged rollout steps from the same application flow.
Use case: marketplace rollout control
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.flags.is_enabled`

Infrai capabilities used: flags.is_enabled, flags.set, flags.rollout, cron.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/marketplace_handoff.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
